clips.title: The story
paras: The Letter to Jin'Zil is a piece of correspondence penned by the orc Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads. Entrusted to an adventurer after the defeat of Serena Bloodfeather, it bears word to the Darkspear witch doctor Jin'Zil in the Stonetalon Mountains that the northern Barrens have been purged of the Bloodfeather threat.

Following the eradication of the harpy infestation at the Dry Hills and the slaying of Serena Bloodfeather, Darsok Swiftdagger drafts this missive to an old comrade. Recognizing that the harpies of the Barrens originally roosted within the peaks of Stonetalon Mountains, Darsok uses the dispatch to introduce a promising warrior to the wider frontier while notifying the witch doctor Jin'Zil that the harpy matron has fallen.
